STS2_DEHYA_RELIC_BLAZING_BRACERS.descrip: At the start of each combat, gain 7 [gold]Plating[/gold] and 2 [gold]Regen[/gold].
STS2_DEHYA_RELIC_BLAZING_BRACERS.flavor: Blazing resolve spreads through the bracers — she is the burning sun of the desert.
STS2_DEHYA_RELIC_BLAZING_BRACERS.title: Blazing Bracers
STS2_DEHYA_RELIC_GILDED_COOKPOT.descript: When you pick this up, heal [blue]{Heal}[/blue] HP. The first time you lose HP each combat, gain [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
STS2_DEHYA_RELIC_GILDED_COOKPOT.flavor: The stew tastes faintly of metal. They say those who grow used to it move a little faster.
STS2_DEHYA_RELIC_GILDED_COOKPOT.title: Gilded Cookpot
STS2_DEHYA_RELIC_PAINKILLERS.description: Whenever you lose HP during your turn, heal [blue]{Heal}[/blue] HP.
STS2_DEHYA_RELIC_PAINKILLERS.flavor: Bitter enough to make anyone wince. On the battlefield, who has time to taste it?
STS2_DEHYA_RELIC_PAINKILLERS.title: Painkillers
STS2_DEHYA_RELIC_SCARRED_TRAINING_POST.d: Attacks you play that cost 0 deal [blue]{ExtraDamage}[/blue] additional damage.
STS2_DEHYA_RELIC_SCARRED_TRAINING_POST.f: The post is covered in blade marks and burn scars. It has never been the one to fall.
STS2_DEHYA_RELIC_STILL_WARM_BRACERS.desc: At the start of each combat, gain 5 [gold]Plating[/gold] and heal 2 HP.
STS2_DEHYA_RELIC_STILL_WARM_BRACERS.flav: Bracers that keep their warmth long after being taken off — their owner never strays far from the frontline.
STS2_DEHYA_RELIC_TOY_WOODEN_SWORD.descri: At the end of your turn, if you still have [gold]Block[/gold], deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to a random enemy.
STS2_DEHYA_RELIC_TOY_WOODEN_SWORD.flavor: Children use it to play the hero. When Dehya swings it, she is not playing.
STS2_DEHYA_RELIC_TOY_WOODEN_SWORD.title: Toy Wooden Sword
